headline: Make authorization evidence reviewable without automating the decision
capabilities: Pull payer‑specific requirements and match them with EHR data
Compile the full clinical evidence packet needed for medical review
Submit requests directly to payer portals and send real‑time updates
Flag cases requiring additional documentation and prepare appeal materials proactively
outcomes: Completed authorizations faster by relying on fewer manual steps
Met payer criteria consistently, reducing denials
Received timely notifications, enabling earlier appointment booking
Gained clear visibility into authorization progress, reducing anxiety and delays
why_try: The demo makes a difficult governance boundary concrete: AI can organize evidence and uncertainty while a qualified reviewer retains policy interpretation, medical-necessity reasoning, and every outcome.
